Thursday Dec 3 TUL8TE Nov 25, 2026

TUL8TE takes Red Bull Symphonic to Mohamed Ali Palace

TUL8TE performs his songs reimagined with a full orchestra conducted by Nayer Nagui, at the third edition of Red Bull Symphonic Egypt — Thursday, Dec 3 at Mohamed Ali Palace, Shubra El Kheima. Doors 6 PM, show 7 PM, seated, Black Tie dress code, tickets via TicketsMarche. Moved from Friday, Nov 27 in mourning for the victims of the Al-Warraq Ring Road accident; tickets remain valid for the new date.

Postponed Ziad Zaza Nov 26, 2026

Ziad Zaza postpones his 7 new songs

Ziad Zaza has postponed the seven new songs — not two, as he corrected himself — due this Thursday, November 26, out of mourning for the victims of the Al-Warraq Ring Road accident. He announced it in his story: “تم تأجيل الألبوم الذي كان من المقرر نزوله غدًا، احترامًا وتقديرًا لموتانا وشهدائنا”. No new date yet — Cairo Frequency will post when the drop is rescheduled.

Record night Fadl Shaker Nov 24, 2026

Fadl Shaker draws 26,000 fans across two sold-out Abu Dhabi nights

Fadl Shaker drew more than 26,000 fans across two sold-out nights at Etihad Arena in Abu Dhabi — November 20 and 23 — a record for the organisers, Moments Events. The first night sold out instantly, forcing a second night on a Monday, which sold out too. Fadl was honoured on stage at the end of the second night and performed his new song “Omri El Baky” live for the first time. The first night featured his son Mohamed Shaker. Cairo Frequency covered it on Instagram with a mention for @fadelchaker.

About Cairo Frequency

What we do

Cairo Frequency is an independent digital news page covering Egyptian and Arab music and celebrity news — new releases, concerts, festivals and the stories artists break on their own channels.

We monitor the artists we cover every 30 minutes, around the clock. When a song drops or a concert is announced, the story goes out on our Instagram first — artwork carrying the news and the CF mark, with the full details in the caption — and the confirmed stories are collected here.

Our coverage is in English, for Arab music fans everywhere.
